data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 开发室里的突发吻痕
data.description: 狭窄的元器件储物间内，呼吸交叠得毫无缝隙。红莉栖被抵在木质货架旁，双手下意识攥紧对方的衣角，半咬着下唇承受着滚烫的吻，眼角泛起失控的水汽。
data.location: narrow secluded parts storage closet between tall wooden shelving units
data.action: pinned gently against storage shelves, camisole slipping off one shoulder, gripping partner shirt with trembling fingers during a breathless heated embrace
data.lighting: dim amber light filtering under door crack illuminating flushed damp skin
data.mood: steamy enclosed passion, forbidden laboratory tryst, desperate sweet surrender
data.promptProse: Pressed against a wooden bookshelf in the dark storage room, flushed Kurisu bites her lip with teary eyes as hands caress her bare trembling shoulder.
data.animaCaption: Kurisu pinned gently against a backroom shelf, flushed with passionate desire.
